items.label: Create Your Magical Water Elf in 3 Easy Steps
items.value: Simply add colorful magic gel to a mold, dip it in the special solution, and watch it transform into a lifelike water pet! A perfect arts and crafts for kids ages 4-8 who love hands-on play.

items.label: Complete Craft Kit for More Creativity
items.value: This all-in-one magic water gel toy kit includes 10 vibrant colors (6 basic magic gel, 2 sparkling magic gel, and 2 glowing magic gel), 8 molds, 2 packs of magic powder, a pair of gloves, a fish bottle and a net. Designed for minimal mess, maximum fun! A creative crafts for girls 8-12!

items.label: Exclusive Display Bottle to Preserve Your Creation
items.value: The included display bottle allows children to preserve their magical water pets as a fun keepsake or decorative item. If made with the two special glow-in-the-dark gels in the set, the glow-in-the-dark water elf in the bottle will also emit an enchanting glow at night. Place the bottle by your bed and it will become a wonderful nighttime companion.

items.label: Safe and Non-toxic Magic Gel
items.value: At Coodoo, safety comes first. The magic gel is made from non-toxic, environmentally friendly materials, and the molds all have smooth edges to protect children's delicate hands. Rigorously tested in international laboratories, this magic water elf craft kit ensures a worry-free DIY play experience.

items.label: An Ideal Craft Gift for Creative Kids
items.value: This magical water elf toy kit is perfect for parent-child activities, children's parties, and festivals. It enriches family time, adds fun to games, encourages DIY, and provides children with a unique creative experience. This arts and crafts for kids ages 8-12 is a perfect gift.
